scoring_justification: Main claim is about domain wall energetics ordering and competition, expressed as relative trends and degeneracy conditions; structural checks on ordering and crossing are appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference total energies at s=-1.8% from paper text (Fig.5) and strain thresholds for domain wall ordering from paper narrative; decomposition ordering knowledge from Fig.6.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Strain-induced control of domain wall morphology in ultrathin PbTiO3 films', Phys. Rev. B 89, 214113 (2014), Figs. 5 and 6 and surrounding text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: total energies explicit at s=-1.8% (-34.32, -34.11, -34.36 meV); ordering statements from text (100-type favored for s>-1.6%, 110-type favored for s<-2.1%, wandering near-degenerate around -1.8%); decomposition ordering from Figure 6 description.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values and statements are direct quotes from the paper; they serve as the gold reference for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Energy decomposition of the three domain wall morphologies (100-type, 110-type, wandering) as a function of misfit strain at 6 K. The checker compares the energy differences and component ordering against hidden reference values to verify the strain-driven competition and the window for wandering walls.

output_contract.notes: The solver must implement the effective Hamiltonian and run MC simulations from scratch; no precomputed energies are provided.

steps.description: Validate CSV structure and required contents.
Check total energy ordering and crossing as a function of strain.
Check decomposition component ordering for domain wall competition.
